data.body:
=== LIVE EVIDENCE: THE OPERATOR-ATTESTED AC IS NOW SATISFIED. THE CELL IS GREEN ON A REAL DC
INSTANCE. ===

RUN: GitHub Actions 30765232591, job 'jira DC harness smoke (real Jira Data Center, ephemeral)',
job id 91542617555, against main @ 2ea5c3391d — the tree containing BOTH of this ticket's commits
(8961f12664 'extract DC transition cluster', 2ea5c3391d 'route DC outbound status to a transition').
Duration 1608.76s.

RESULT: **1 failed, 48 passed**, and the all-skip canary confirms nothing was silently skipped:
    [jira-live-canary] collected=49 executed=49 skipped=0
That canary line matters and was checked deliberately — this epic has twice been misled by cells
vanishing from collection (change 1203 had to restore _live_jira_ready to two modules after a
refactor removed them from the canary), so 'green' is only meaningful alongside an executed count.

THIS TICKET'S CELL, EXPLICITLY:
    PASSED tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_outbound_mutation_round_trips[04-transition-status]
    PASSED tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_inbound_mutation_round_trips[04-transition-status]
Both directions of the transition cell are green. The BASELINE for comparison is recorded in the
previous comment: the immediately preceding run (30763838558, main @ 144bb02251, pre-fix) failed
that same outbound cell with 'AssertionError: outbound status did not reach DC: fields.status.name
is To Do'. Same harness, same cell, same instance configuration — the only material difference is
this fix. That is a controlled before/after, not a bare green.

ONE METHOD NOTE, because I nearly recorded the opposite conclusion. My first read of the log grepped
a '8 passed' summary line and I briefly believed collection had collapsed from 49 cells to 9. It had
not — that line belonged to a different pytest session in the same job log, and the canary line above
is the authoritative one. Separately, the transition cell appears in the log under a
'___ test_name ___' banner, which is pytest's FAILURES-section format and reads alarmingly; it is in
fact the per-test 'Captured log call' banner that EVERY cell gets, including the neighbouring
[05-add-link] and [06-remove-link] cells. Checked the explicit PASSED lines rather than inferring
from either. Recording both misreads so the next reader of a harness log does not repeat them.

THE OTHER FAILURE IN THIS RUN IS NOT THIS TICKET'S: it is
test_the_inbound_assignee_mints_a_jira_family_identity, failing on its own SETUP precondition
('the store copy ALREADY maps jira/admin ... so a mapping afterwards would prove nothing about this
pass'). That is ticket 5200's rewritten oracle correctly refusing to pass vacuously, is tracked
there, and has a fix in progress. It does not bear on this ticket's verdict.
